description: Meal ideas from the promotions (kookinspiratie): the dishes whose main ingredients are all in promotion at the given Belgian food store(s) on the day the user shops, with those promotions (price, deal, until when, link), the side ingredients that are in promotion too, and what else is needed that is not. Dish ideas for a shopping list, not recipes. Without stores: per food store how many dishes its promotions make today.

day.description: The shopping day: an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), 'today', 'tomorrow' or a weekday ('zaterdag', 'saturday'). Within the next 7 days. Default: today.

moment.description: Kind of dish. Default: hoofdgerecht (main course).

offset.description: Skip this many dishes (for the next page).

stores.description: One or more food stores, comma separated, by name or slug, e.g. 'Aldi', 'aldi, lidl', 'Delhaize'. Optional.

vegetarian.description: Only vegetarian dishes, and only promotions without meat or fish. Default false.

name: get_meal_ideas
